patthana19.1:2.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā, na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā citta samuṭṭhānañcarūpaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā upajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.1:3.1: na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.1:4.1: na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, pañca.
patthana19.1:5.1: na kusalañca na abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na kusalañca na abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na kusalañca na abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi
patthana19.1:6.1: na akusalaṃ ca na abyākataṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. na akusalaṃ ca na abyākataṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. na akusalañca na abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na akusalañca na abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.1:7.1: na kusalañca na akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana19.1:8.1: na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā. na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā,
patthana19.1:9.1: na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā, na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇa paccayā,
patthana19.1:10.1: na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā. na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā,
patthana19.1:11.1: na kusalañca na abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā,
patthana19.1:12.1: na akusalañca na abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā,
patthana19.1:13.1: na kusalañca na akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā,
patthana19.1:14.1: hetuyā aṭṭhārasa. ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā aṭṭhārasa, avigate aṭṭhārasa.
patthana19.1:15.1: na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā, …pe… na kusalañca na akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā,
patthana19.1:16.1: na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati na ārammaṇapaccayā, …pe… na kusalañca na akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā,
patthana19.1:17.1: na hetuyā cha, na ārammaṇe cha, na adhipatiyā aṭṭhārasa, no vigate cha,
patthana19.1:19.1: ārammaṇe cha, na hetupaccayā ārammaṇe cha, (sahajātavāraṃpi
patthana19.1:21.1: na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, pañca.
patthana19.1:22.1: na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, pañca.
patthana19.1:23.1: na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo-. satta pañca.
patthana19.1:24.1: na kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā-. satta. tīṇi,
patthana19.1:25.1: na akusalañca na abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā-. satta. tīṇi. na kusalañca na akusalañca dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, satta. pañca.
patthana19.1:26.1: hetuyā chabbīsati, ārammaṇe terasa. avigate chabbīsati,
patthana19.1:29.1: na kusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. na kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. na kusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa hetu paccayena paccayo.
patthana19.1:30.1: na akusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, tīṇi.
patthana19.1:31.1: abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. pañca.
patthana19.1:32.1: na kusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. tīṇi.
patthana19.1:33.1: na akusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. tīṇi.
patthana19.1:34.1: na kusalo ca na akusalo ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. ekaṃ. na
patthana19.1:35.1: akusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi.
patthana19.1:36.1: na akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo, tīṇi.
patthana19.1:37.1: na abyākato dhammo abyākatassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi.
patthana19.1:38.1: na kusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. na kusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. na kusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi.
patthana19.1:39.1: na akusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. na akusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. na akusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo, tīṇi.
patthana19.1:40.1: na kusalo ca na abyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo, tīṇi.
patthana19.1:41.1: hetuyā aṭṭhārasa, ārammaṇe aṭṭhārasa, adhipatiyā tevīsa, avigate dvāvīsa, (pañhāvāraṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.) na sukhāya vedanā
